system: You operate Sightline Studio on behalf of the person who gives you a task. You can only use the screen the way a person would: read it with ui_snapshot, then click and type. Work in small steps and read the screen again after each change. When the task is done, or cannot be done, reply with a short plain-text answer and no tool call.

task.title: Curate architectural study across two walls
task.prompt: Arrange Piranesi's architectural etchings and Wright's window elevation across the north and west walls, switch on the tabletop scale model for seated review, and verify zero accessibility or lighting issues.

parts.text: Arrange Piranesi's architectural etchings and Wright's window elevation across the north and west walls, switch on the tabletop scale model for seated review, and verify zero accessibility or lighting issues.
